source_ranges.claim: Conservative stable Q-function convention and minimal q-transition construction
source_ranges.conditions: Borel state space; off-diagonal kernel nonnegative finite; conservative q; source stability condition sup over all time of each state’s total rate finite.
source_ranges.scope_limit: This is the source Q-function construction; it does not assert arbitrary test functions lie in a pointwise generator domain.

source_ranges.conditions: Theorem Proposition 2.2 uses a set Γ with sup over x in Γ and all times of q_x finite.
source_ranges.proof_support: The proposition cites Corollary 4.2 of Feinberg et al.; that imported result is not independently reproved here.

source_ranges.claim: Nonexplosion/explosion criteria for nonhomogeneous pure-jump Q-processes
source_ranges.conditions: Theorem 3.1 is the source’s equivalence for its stable conservative Q-function model; Theorem 3.2 gives a sharp drift criterion with necessity only under locally compact separable metric state space, local rate bounds and weak-Feller transition conditions.
source_ranges.proof_scope: The paper supplies its proof structure; stability theory tools cited from Meyn–Tweedie and related results are not independently verified.

source_ranges.claim: Practical finite-horizon drift condition and Dynkin-formula applicability via transformed process
source_ranges.conditions: Corollary 3.2 is derived for the specified finite-horizon truncations; Theorem 4.1 concerns c-drift functions and the f-transformed Q-process.
source_ranges.scope_limit: These results do not prove J01’s generic local generator-limit identity for every test function.
Appendix arguments and citations read; cited results remain external dependencies.
